selection_rule: Eligible solutions: equal average rank of silhouette descending, Davies-Bouldin ascending, resample ARI descending, coordinate agreement descending, and elevation/temperature/precipitation within-cluster variance ratio ascending. Tie: smaller K then method lexical order. No eligibility means no recommendation.
drift_severity: max absolute annual temperature/precipitation anomaly divided by baseline interannual sample SD: <1 LOW, <2 MODERATE, otherwise HIGH; descriptive statistical bands, not agronomic thresholds
